KEN.note: Training is for women and community members, not civil servants.

facts.fact: KICTANet and partners, with the Nyandarua county government, ran the SheConnects Digital Accelerator trainer-of-trainers workshop in August 2026 for about 100 women and men, each asked to train 50 more, after USAID funding fell through.

KEN.note: Document reports a training workshop by KICTANet, not research or publication on digital policy.
